preconditions.description: Attacker must hold some amount of the honeyToken to initiate transfer
Contract must have non-zero CHARITY_FEE set (default is set in constructor)

exploit_hint: The vulnerability is in the _reflectFee function where charity fee is subtracted from _rTotal but not from _tTotal (unlike burn fee). This creates an inconsistency between reflection supply and token supply. Exploit by: 1. Ensure you have some tokens, 2. Make a transfer to trigger fee calculation, 3. The charity portion is deducted from _rTotal but not _tTotal, causing the rate calculation to be skewed. Repeated transfers can amplify the effect. The attacker's balance in reflection terms decreases less than it should, effectively increasing their token balance relative to others.
